issues.problem: The four lasers are registered as blue_clay_laser / green_clay_laser / red_clay_laser / white_clay_laser. The machine ledger (OriginalRegistryCatalog family ClayEnergyLaser, stem clay_energy_laser, Tier 7-10) and the AGENTS.md rule say machine-series IDs are `<stem>_tier_<Tier>`.
issues.reason: The other catalog series (e.g. the M23 interfaces, whose tsv names are also non-tier names) are registered by OriginalRegistryCatalog.machineId. These lasers ignore the ledger, so the registered IDs and the catalog name different IDs for the same original varieties.
issues.fix: Register the lasers as clay_energy_laser_tier_7..10 via OriginalRegistryCatalog.machineId. Update the four tsv rows, the lang/blockstate/model/loot outputs (re-run runData) and the E2E setblock IDs to match.

IDs via machineId; tsv updated.

issues.problem: A reflector forwards each beam it receives synchronously and immediately. The Laser Interface relays only receiveLaser(long,long,long), so the beam age is lost. If a reflector points at a Laser Interface synchronized to that same reflector, the beam re-enters with age 0 every time. The result is unbounded recursion (StackOverflowError) on the server. Also, two beams arriving in the same tick are forwarded separately rather than as one merged beam, so the age>=10 maximum-merge rule never reaches the downstream receiver.
issues.reason: A loop the player can build crashes the server, and the reflector does not output the merged laser the original rules call for.
issues.fix: Override receiveLaser(LaserBeam, Direction) in InterfaceBlockEntity so it relays the LaserBeam with its age. Make the reflector accumulate the beams received during a tick with LaserBeam.merge and emit the merged beam once from its serverTick instead of delivering recursively inside receiveLaser.

history.note: fixed: インターフェースが age を含むビームを中継し、反射器が同一 tick のビームを合成して次 tick に送ります。
Interface relays LaserBeam; reflector merges and emits next tick, no recursion.
The diff does not touch the reflector or the interface relay, so the earlier fix stands.

issues.problem: FACING=UP uses x=90 and FACING=DOWN uses x=270. The models put the front texture or plate on the north face, and an x=90 rotation moves north to down. Up-facing lasers therefore show their front texture on the bottom, and the up-facing reflector plate renders at the bottom while its VoxelShape UP is at the top (the reverse for DOWN).
issues.reason: The emission direction and the reflector orientation shown in the world disagree with the actual beam direction and hitbox, which fails the 向き/反射 display requirement.
issues.fix: Swap the vertical rotations (UP -> x=270, DOWN -> x=90) and regenerate the blockstates with runData.

history.note: fixed: 上下方向のモデル回転を入れ替え、blockstate を再生成しました。
UP=270, DOWN=90 in generated blockstates.
The diff does not touch the blockstate rotations, so the earlier fix stands.

issues.problem: The UVs use sprite.getU(0|16) and sprite.getV(0|16). In 1.21.1, TextureAtlasSprite.getU/getV take a normalized 0..1 coordinate, so 16 samples far outside the laser sprite and draws other atlas textures on the beam.
issues.reason: The beam does not show the original laser.png, so the original look and colors are lost.
issues.fix: Use sprite.getU0()/getU1() and getV0()/getV1() (or getU(0F)/getU(1F)).

history.note: fixed: ビームのUVをスプライトの U0/U1/V0/V1 に修正しました。
Uses getU0/U1/V0/V1.
The diff does not touch the renderer UVs, so the earlier fix stands.

issues.problem: The renderer returns true from shouldRenderOffScreen but does not override getRenderBoundingBox. NeoForge still frustum-culls block-entity renderers against that box, which defaults to the block's own bounds. A beam up to 32 blocks long disappears whenever the emitter or reflector block is outside the view.
issues.reason: The AC requires the beams to stay visible without disappearing (透明化がない) when viewed from the side, front or crossing point.
issues.fix: Override getRenderBoundingBox(T) to return the block AABB expanded along direction() by laserLength(), and drop the shouldRenderOffScreen override if it becomes unnecessary.

history.note: fixed: 描画境界をビームの方向と長さに沿って拡張しました。
getRenderBoundingBox expands along beam.
The diff does not touch the render bounding box, so the earlier fix stands.

issues.problem: Every beam is centered on its block's center line and its half-width depends only on the component sum. Two crossing beams of the same strength at the same height, like the red/green pair in clay-lasers.mjs, have top and bottom faces in exactly the same plane inside the crossing square, which causes z-fighting.
issues.reason: The AC explicitly requires no z-fighting at the crossing point, and the approach calls for a z-fighting countermeasure.
issues.fix: Give each beam axis a slightly different half-width or offset (e.g. a small per-axis epsilon) so faces of perpendicular beams are never coplanar.

history.note: fixed: ビーム軸ごとに幅の微差を付け、交差面の重なりを避けました。
Per-axis half-width offset.
The diff does not touch the beam widths, so the earlier fix stands.

issues.problem: For a reflector, the outgoing beam starts 0.501 blocks from the center, while the incoming beam ends at the reflector's center. There is a visible half-block gap at the reflection point.
issues.reason: The reflection should appear as one continuous beam that turns at the reflector.
issues.fix: Start the reflector's outgoing beam at the block center (or at the plate). Keep the 0.501 offset only for emitters, whose body is a full cube.

history.note: fixed: 反射器の出射ビームをブロック中心から描画します。
Reflector start distance is 0.
The diff does not touch the reflector beam start, so the earlier fix stands.

issues.reason: This is test-only production code, and it lets the GameTest skip the CE supply path the game actually uses.
issues.fix: Remove receiveClayEnergy and fuel the lasers in the GameTest by inserting compressed energetic clay into the fuel slot through the ItemHandler capability.

history.note: fixed: テスト専用のCE注入経路を削除し、GameTest は燃料スロットの Capability から給油します。
receiveClayEnergy removed; test fuels via capability.
The diff does not bring back receiveClayEnergy, so the earlier fix stands.

issues.problem: The nonlinear effect is only checked on a LaserBeam merged by hand, with the weak inequality merged.energy() > 4*energy(1,1,1), not on what the receiver got and not against original values. The reflection check reads only the blue component and does not show that the original target stops receiving. The redstone-stopped case asserts only the CE and not that the receiver got nothing. No vertical (UP/DOWN) emission direction is tested.
issues.reason: Each GameTest must perform the criterion's Action and assert its Expected Result: exact CE/t, the white 3/3/3 composition, the original nonlinear values, the reflection direction and the redstone stop.
issues.fix: Assert LaserBeam.energy() against exact values computed from the original formula for representative beams (e.g. [1,0,0], [3,3,3], [4,4,4]) for the beam the receiver accumulated. Assert all three components after reflection and that the old straight-line target receives nothing. Assert that receivers get nothing while the laser is stopped. Include an UP or DOWN laser.

history.note: fixed: 実受信値の非線形効果、2本の反射合成、旧直進先の停止、赤石停止、上向き照射を検証します。
Tests assert exact values, reflection merge, stop, upward.
The diff changes only the batch name of an unrelated ClayProduction GameTest, so the laser GameTests are unchanged.

issues.problem: The emitter saves the derived runtime state irradiating and laser_length to disk. The reflector saves its visible beam, age, length and irradiating state. All of these are recomputed on the next tick (pathDirty=true), and the reflector clamps the loaded values with Math.max even though the game only produces non-negative values. LaserBeam's compact constructor also throws on negative values the game never produces.
issues.reason: Runtime display state does not need to be saved, and the extra validation guards states the game cannot produce, which the code style forbids.
issues.fix: Save only inventory and energy in saveAdditional, and send irradiating, laser_length and the visible beam only through getUpdateTag. Remove the Math.max clamps and the LaserBeam negativity check.

history.note: fixed: 永続化は燃料在庫とCEに絞り、描画状態は更新タグで同期します。不要な値域ガードも削除しました。
Runtime state only in update tag; clamps and checks removed.
The diff does not touch the laser block entity persistence, so the earlier fix stands.

issues.problem: The new receiveLaser(LaserBeam, Direction incomingSide) parameter is never used by any implementation. The reflector's long-triple override passes a dummy Direction.NORTH and drops the age.
issues.reason: An unused parameter plus a fake value is unnecessary abstraction, and it hides that the age is lost on that path.
issues.fix: Drop the incomingSide parameter and make the LaserBeam overload the single path that carries the age. Have the long-triple entry point build a LaserBeam only where an implementation actually needs it.

history.note: fixed: 未使用の入射面引数を除き、LaserBeam を受け渡す経路に統一しました。
incomingSide removed; single LaserBeam path.
The diff does not touch the LaserReceiver API, so the earlier fix stands.

issues.problem: `ticket_status=active` is saved, and serverTick returns early while the status is ACTIVE. After a restart, the restart validation can remove a real loader's saved tickets. This happens when the forced-chunk data and the chunk data were saved at different times (for example after a crash), or when the ticket set was incomplete. The block entity then loads as ACTIVE and never asks for tickets again. It shows 'active' but keeps no chunks loaded.
issues.reason: AC-F029-002 requires a legitimate loader to get back the tickets it needs after a restart. The GameTest only passes because it overwrites the status with `waiting` through loadWithComponents. A real restart never does that.
issues.fix: After a load, re-check the tickets once on the first server tick whatever status was saved. For example, keep ACTIVE only for the running session: do not restore ACTIVE from NBT, or reset it to WAITING in loadAdditional. Persist only the `unavailable` result the GUI needs. Remove the GameTest's manual `ticket_status` overwrite so the test runs the real reload path.

issues.problem: Restored owners are tracked in a static, JVM-wide `RESTORED_OWNERS` set. The set is never cleared when the server stops. Entries for loaders that are already ACTIVE are never consumed, because acquire is never called for them. In single-player, these entries carry over to the next world loaded in the same JVM. There, a loader at the same position skips the rejection check. The set also needs extra hooks (`forgetRestoredOwner`, `onChunkUnloaded`) only to keep itself consistent.
issues.reason: Static mutable state that outlives the server breaks lifecycle correctness. It is also an extra abstraction that NeoForge does not need: once the callback has validated the tickets, they are already held in ForcedChunksSavedData.
issues.fix: Remove `RESTORED_OWNERS`, `Owner`, `forgetRestoredOwner` and the `onChunkUnloaded` override. In acquire, count a chunk whose ticket the owner already holds as acquired. The ticket is already held when forceChunk returns false because it already exists, so check the controller's held tickets directly. Treat only a ticket that is missing after the request as a rejection.

issues.problem: In NeoForge 21.1, `TicketController.forceChunk` returns false only when the same owner already holds that ticket. The code treats that result as a 'server rejection' and then releases every ticket the owner holds, including the valid ones it already had. The GameTest creates the 'rejection' the same way, by adding a duplicate ticket for the same owner beforehand. So the rejection path being tested is a duplicate ticket, not a server constraint.
issues.reason: AC-F029-001's 'tickets rejected because of a server constraint' must mean the requested ticket was not granted. Losing tickets the loader already held because of a duplicate is wrong behavior.
issues.fix: Count rejection only when, after the request, the owner still does not hold the ticking ticket for that chunk. Give an already-held ticket the success result. In the GameTest, create the rejection precondition through a real non-granted request rather than a pre-added duplicate for the same owner.

issues.problem: The test does not set up the precondition or observe the result the criterion requires. The loader is not placed on a chunk boundary (it sits at relative 1,2,1 with no boundary check). No ticks pass after the tickets are acquired. 'Running' is only checked as `getChunkNow != null` (loaded), not as ticking. The test never checks that chunks outside the 3×3 area are not loaded by the loader.
issues.reason: AC-F029-001 Preconditions/Action/Expected: place the loader on a chunk boundary, advance ticks, observe the center and its 8 neighbours running, and confirm no extra surrounding chunks are loaded.
issues.fix: Place the loader on a block whose coordinates are on a chunk boundary (for example x%16==15 or 0), confirmed with a require. Advance ticks with runAfterDelay/succeedWhen. Assert the 9 chunks are ticking (for example `level.shouldTickBlocksAt` or `isNaturalSpawningAllowed` for each chunk). Assert that the ring of chunks at distance 2 has no ticket or ticking state from this loader.

issues.problem: The 'restart' is simulated by calling `ForcedChunkManager.reinstatePersistentChunks` while the tickets are still live in the DistanceManager. The test checks only the serialized ForcedChunksSavedData. The validation callback removes the orphan tickets from saved data, but the orphan's live tickets stay in the level, so its 9 chunks remain force-loaded after the test. Dimension unload, an Action listed in the criterion, is not exercised at all.
issues.reason: AC-F029-002 expects that no orphan tickets remain and that ticket release is checked for removal, dimension unload and restart. Checking only saved data does not prove that no orphan tickets remain, and the test leaves chunks loaded for later GameTests.
issues.fix: Check the live ticket state (the level's DistanceManager / ticking state of the chunks) as well as the saved data. Make sure the orphan's live tickets are gone, for example by clearing them before the simulated reinstate so the saved data is the only source, as on a real startup. Clean up every ticket the test creates. Cover dimension unload, or state in AGENTS.md and the acceptance mapping how it is verified.

issues.problem: `getUpdatePacket`, `getUpdateTag` and `sendBlockUpdated` send the ticket status to the client block entity, but nothing on the client reads it. The screen reads the status from the menu's ContainerData.
issues.reason: Code style: remove code the current behavior does not use.
issues.fix: Remove `getUpdatePacket`, `getUpdateTag` and the `sendBlockUpdated` call. Keep `setChanged`.

issues.problem: The lang key `container.clayium.chunk_loader` is generated into en_us/ja_jp, but nothing uses it. `getDisplayName` returns the block name.
issues.reason: Code style: remove resources the current behavior does not use.
issues.fix: Delete the entry and regenerate `en_us.json` and `ja_jp.json` with runData.

issues.problem: `ticketStatus()` guards against ordinals outside the enum range and maps them to UNAVAILABLE. The server only ever sends `TicketStatus.ordinal()`, so that state cannot happen.
issues.reason: Code style: validate only states the game can produce.
issues.fix: Return `TicketStatus.values()[data.get(0)]` directly.
